title: Context-Verified, Error-Budget-Aware Decomposition Selection for Toffoli Networks
summary: Two-qubit-gate error dominates the failure budget of near-term quantum circuits, so the decomposition chosen for each Toffoli (CCX) gate should minimize hardware two-qubit infidelity, not gate count. The cheapest decompositions - relative-phase and approximate Toffolis - are only correct in context: their residual phase or bounded error must be cancelled or absorbed downstream. We present the first compiler pass that selects a per-Toffoli decomposition to minimize a two-qubit-infidelity error budget.
